svg.text: A187 — the basin containment map of the alive residue

63 ALIVE gallery pages (52 a57v4 + 11 k0v4) against every certified local certificate. 7 pages have a basin for their OWN nearest minimiser in their own class frame; 8 have their conditioned box inside a certified basin box; 7 have their A107 representative configuration inside a certified N (the A116/A151/A160/A163 consumer test). 11 pages sit in a frame with no basin at all.

A CAVEAT ON 'inside': a certified N asks for a square in EACH of its boxes; an alive page conditions ONE square. Box containment is therefore NECESSARY for the LocalCompose YES leaf to cover the page, not sufficient — the other boxes are what the NO children (A120/A136) still have to supply.
A187, 2026-09-09. Sources: docs/shadows/STATUS.md; A148 gallery records; A107 struct_op/cfg; basins A119/A125/A160/A163. Read-only.
